## Summary

Describe the requested feature in one or two sentences.

## Problem or use case

What are you trying to do that XL Logic does not handle well yet?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you want.

## Affected area

- [ ] Runtime / Python execution
- [ ] Screens / rendering
- [ ] Networking / discovery / XLAPI
- [ ] Redstone / sensors
- [ ] Material I/O
- [ ] Crafting I/O / Crafting CPU
- [ ] No-code builder
- [ ] Documentation / website

## Example workflow

If possible, describe how this would work in-game or in Python.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any workaround or alternative approach you have already considered.

## Extra context

Anything else that would help evaluate the request.
